assessments.reasoning: The publisher archive links the exact 15.0 HTML, whose title identifies the ECMAScript 2024 Language Specification. The PDF cover independently identifies the June 2024 edition. The freshly acquired exact publisher bytes match the frozen SHA-256 eabb3c1fc6c5b0610b143ef7bea8de7c0f323a777d669a453e47c39a2986c846. Module Environment Record CreateImportBinding step 3 establishes the initialized immutable redirection. GetBindingValue step 3 forwards retrieval to the target. Immutability describes the local binding's indirection while access reads the current target binding. The frozen scope identifies the concrete Module Environment Record operations and does not cover all environment records or module-loader APIs. The GetBindingValue steps explicitly allow missing target environments and uninitialized bindings to raise ReferenceError despite local initialization. The separately acquired Corrigendum 1 replaces the copyright notice without altering this clause.

limitations: Indirection does not make the target value immutable. A target environment that is not instantiated or a target binding that is uninitialized can still cause ReferenceError.
